title: Advanced settings: SNI handling lists and a misdocumented global SSL bypass setting

prose.text: The advanced settings have per-application lists and one setting whose provider documentation is wrong. The tenant-wide behavior is in [[zia.url-filtering.advanced-settings]].

checks.do: What an SNI override list means before editing it: prefer_sni_over_conn_host_apps lists applications exempted from the setting, not applications it is applied to.

sni-apps-exempted.statement: prefer_sni_over_conn_host_apps lists applications exempted from the preferSniOverConnHost setting, which otherwise uses the TLS client-hello SNI for DNS resolution instead of the CONNECT host for forward proxy connections.

quotes: `prefer_sni_over_conn_host_apps` - (Set of String) Applications that are exempted from the preferSniOverConnHost setting (i.e., prefer SSL/TLS client hello SNI for DNS resolution instead of the CONNECT host for forward proxy connections).

domain-fronting-apps.statement: block_domain_fronting_apps lists applications subjected to domain fronting handling, alongside the block_domain_fronting_on_host_header advanced setting, which blocks or allows HTTP/S transactions whose request URL FQDN differs from the FQDN of the host header.

quotes: `block_domain_fronting_apps` - (Set of String) Applications which are subjected to Domain Fronting.

`block_domain_fronting_on_host_header` - (Boolean) Value indicating whether to block or allow HTTP/S transactions in which the FQDN of the request URL is different than the FQDN of the request's host header.

go-global-ssl-bypass-description.statement: The Go SDK describes enableEvaluatePolicyOnGlobalSSLBypass as whether policy evaluation for global SSL bypass traffic is enabled.

quotes: // A Boolean value indicating whether policy evaluation for global SSL bypass traffic is enabled or not

tf-global-ssl-bypass-description.statement: The Terraform documentation describes enable_evaluate_policy_on_global_ssl_bypass as enabling or disabling DNS optimization for all IPv6 transparent proxy traffic.

quotes: `enable_evaluate_policy_on_global_ssl_bypass` - (Boolean) Enable/Disable DNS optimization for all IPv6 transparent proxy traffic.

global-ssl-bypass-description.summary: The Terraform documentation and the Go SDK describe enableEvaluatePolicyOnGlobalSSLBypass as two different settings.

positions.says: It enables or disables DNS optimization for all IPv6 transparent proxy traffic.

quotes: `enable_evaluate_policy_on_global_ssl_bypass` - (Boolean) Enable/Disable DNS optimization for all IPv6 transparent proxy traffic.

positions.says: It says whether policy evaluation for global SSL bypass traffic is enabled.

quotes: // A Boolean value indicating whether policy evaluation for global SSL bypass traffic is enabled or not

global-ssl-bypass-description.impact: An operator reading only the provider documentation would not learn that this switch decides whether URL policy is evaluated on globally SSL-bypassed traffic; see the URL filtering advanced-settings subject for the effect.
